findings.title: Write lock held across I/O without re-checking cache
findings.body: GetWebAssets takes entryPointAssetsCacheMu.RLock to snapshot the cache, releases it, then unconditionally takes entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock and performs file and potentially network I/O (readWebAssetsFromFile/CDN, GetContentDeliveryURL) while holding the exclusive lock, without re-reading entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring it. Two goroutines that both observe nil on the fast path will therefore both do the full load serially and last-writer-wins, and all concurrent readers block on RLock for the duration of that I/O. In Dev mode where the fast path never hits, every call takes the exclusive lock and is fully serialized. The fix should re-check the cache after acquiring the write lock and should not hold the exclusive lock across slow I/O (load outside the lock, then swap under lock, or bypass the global entirely in Dev).
